data.title: Meloni government becomes Italy's longest-lasting
data.description: ROME - Giorgia Meloni's hard-right government on Friday becomes the longest-lasting in Italy's postwar history -- a notable record that belies considerable challenges ahead of elections next year.

data.title: UN says world will miss its climate target, warming must be reversed
data.description: NEW YORK — The world has failed in its goal of limiting global warming to 1.5 degrees Celsius above preindustrial times, the United Nations (UN) said Wednesday, in a sober assessment that laid out a new goal for fighting climate change that would set the world on an uncertain path.

data.title: Venice to roll out red carpet for Clooney
data.description: VENICE - The Venice Film Festival kicks off on the sun-splashed Lido with a bang on Wednesday, with the glamorous cinema showcase handing George Clooney a lifetime achievement award on its opening night.

data.title: Mpox, Covid-19 cases continue to rise
data.description: New cases of Mpox and Covid-19 continue to rise since June with the presence of a severer mpox strain and a low fatality rate for Covid-19, according to the Department of Disease Control.

data.title: Khao Kheow Open Zoo to celebrate beloved hippo Mae Mali's 61st birthday
data.description: CHON BURI -Khao Kheow Open Zoo has prepared a special celebration for much-loved Mae Mali, or Mother Mali, Thailand’s oldest hippopotamus, as she marks her 61st birthday on Sept 8.

data.title: Cabinet decides to change location of Korat floral expo
data.description: The Cabinet has agreed to change the venue for an international floral exhibition in Nakhon Ratchasima, a decision that has shocked residents.

data.title: Olivia Rodrigo’s Daisy Chain Fields festival earns $20m for women’s charities
data.description: Pop star Olivia Rodrigo has turned her first music festival into a US$20 million fundraising effort for women’s causes, with the singer’s Daisy Chain Fields drawing 45,000 fans to Great Park in Irvine, California this past Aug 29.

data.title: Funerals in Nepal for missing, a week after deadly floods
data.description: NUWAKOT (NEPAL) - Nepali families have begun holding symbolic funeral ceremonies to "liberate the souls" of loved ones missing since deadly flash floods swept away their villages and homes in the Himalayan region a week ago.

data.title: Hong Kong democracy activist Wong pleads guilty to foreign collusion: AFP
data.description: HONG KONG - Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleaded guilty to foreign collusion on Wednesday in a second national security trial against him that could see him jailed for life, AFP journalists in court saw.

data.title: Nepal's young PM faces gravest test after flood catastrophe
data.description: KATHMANDU — Nepal's rapper-turned-prime minister swept to power six months ago promising reform, but his young government now faces its gravest test after a glacial collapse unleashed catastrophe, analysts say.

data.title: US aircraft carrier approaches Thai port after months at sea
data.description: LAEM CHABANG — A US aircraft carrier at the centre of controversy over conditions on board approached the Thai coast on Wednesday for its first port call in nine months.

data.title: Chinese arrested for illegal travel from Cambodia to Malaysia via Thailand
data.description: CHUMPHON: Highway police arrested five Chinese men and two Thais for carrying no legal travel documents, in this southern province on Saturday night.

data.title: After over 200 days at sea, US aircraft carrier arrives in Thailand
data.description: LAEM CHABANG, ​Chon Buri - ⁠US Navy aircraft carrier Abraham ​Lincoln steamed into Thailand's Laem Chabang deep-sea port on Wednesday morning ​after more than 200 days ‌at sea, including a long deployment in the Middle East, amid reports of mental health concerns and deteriorating conditions aboard.

data.title: German suspect faces extradition
data.description: Mae Hong Son: The Immigration Bureau (IB) has arrested a German man wanted in his country for assaulting and obstructing a public official, after he allegedly evaded arrest for more than three years.

data.title: Macron in Britain to help unveil tapestry, hold Burnham talks
data.description: LONDON - French President Emmanuel Macron begins Wednesday a two-day visit to Britain, inaugurating a landmark exhibition of the Bayeux Tapestry and becoming the first EU leader to meet new Prime Minister Andy Burnham in Downing Street.

data.title: Zelensky warns airlines Russian skies not safe due to Ukraine drones
data.description: KYIV, Ukraine - Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned on Tuesday that his country's drones would make Russia's airspace "completely unsafe" for the duration of the war, drawing accusations of "state terrorism" from Russian leader Vladimir Putin.

data.title: China's Xi to hold talks with Sisi in rare visit to Egypt
data.description: CAIRO - Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to hold talks Wednesday with his Egyptian counterpart on his first visit to Cairo in a decade, under the shadow of looming US sanctions over financial links to Iran.
